title: Steam Input only works in Embedded Game Window and Focused Editor
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.7.1.stable.steam [a13da4feb]
- Reproducible in: 4.7.stable.steam [5b4e0cb0f]
- Reproducible in: 4.6.3.stable.steam [7d41c59c4]

### System information

Godot v4.6.3.stable (7d41c59c4) - Windows 10 (build 19044) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1047) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-11700KF @ 3.60GHz (16 threads) - 31.85 GiB memory

### Issue description

When using the Steam version of the Godot Editor, it does not recognise any Steam-Input controllers until the running **game window is unfocused**, and the **editor is focused**.
Steam Input is **completely ignored** if the game window is _not embedded_.

I've reproduced this with the following controllers (all hooked in through steam input):
- Nintendo Switch 2 Pro Controller
- Nintendo Switch 2 (Nintendo Switch Online) GameCube Controller
- Nintendo Switch Pro Controller
- Generic XBOX One Controller

Below is a video of the bug reproduced using the MRP: 

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cc53bd6e-345a-4721-a7db-2d927b95a429

Currently the work-around i've used is to play with the Game Window embedded, and Floating disabled, so you can re-focus the editor and still see the Game Window (it is also the easiest method to observe the bug).

### Steps to reproduce

1. Install Godot Engine through Steam
2. Ensure you have Steam Input enabled for the software
    1. Open the context menu on the software in your Steam Library
    2. Select "Properties"
    3. Navigate to "Controller"
    4. Set the "Override for Godot Engine" setting to "Enable Steam Input"
6. Start the Engine through Steam and open the MRP
7. Select the 'Game' tab in the Editor and ensure "Embed Game on Next Play" is **enabled**
8. Run the project and ensure the **game window is focused**
9. Attempt to press inputs on your controller, observe no events are printed
10. While the project is running, click on the main editor window to **unfocus the game window**, and **focus the editor**
11. Attempt to press inputs on the controller, and observe the events are now printed

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[steam_input_bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28977708/steam_input_bug.zip)
